about: WO-1096 — shaders taken OUT of the shipped library (repo, ISO, releases). Not shipped: no template here, no data/shaders config on the ISO. The box's own copies were moved to ~/.highascg/backup/wo1096-shaders/ (not in the ISO). src/shaderfx/shader-licence.js RETIRED_SHADER_IDS hides a leftover data/shaders/<id>.json on other boxes until it carries a valid attribution header (title — by author / source URL / License: line) — that header is the opt-in.

optIn.name: Blue Thunder
optIn.reason: origin unknown: no author, URL or licence in the code, and no match in the Shadertoy public-API dumps (Vipitis/shadertoys-dataset to 2021-12, GabeRundlett/shadertoy-api-shaders) or ShaderAmp
optIn.getIt: owner's box copy ~/.highascg/backup/wo1096-shaders/sh-blue-thunder.json; if the owner wrote it (or generated it), add an own-work header (License: AGPL-3.0-or-later) and copy it back to data/shaders/
